articles.title: Kane’s Ballon d’Or triumph a glorious riposte to celebrity fawning of ceremony | Barney Ronay
articles.summary: The England captain spoke movingly on night of deserving winners and unintentional hilarity in London. Well, there’s something new. Football: now available in new, genuinely heartwarming flavour.
body: There was a lovely moment at London’s Palladium theatre, with the clock creeping towards 11pm at the end of a startlingly shrill and bloated evening of never-ending awards and never ending award-related excitement.

Not just for Harry Kane, who is now the 2026 men’s Ballon d’Or winner, and in the process placed indelibly in that lineage of elite footballers. But also, frankly, for anyone watching, as Kane stood on stage gazing a little shyly at his golden orb, and kicked off his speech by thanking everyone, paying tribute to everyone, everywhere, then finally cracking into tears and a strangled croak as he thanked his parents for sacrifices made, his wife for always being there, and even, in slightly jarring vibe-shift from the warm honeyed tone, José Mourinho.
Even Kane’s biggest advocates will rarely claim their man is one of a kind, sui generis, in the mode of the Ronaldo-Messi godhead. But Kane is exactly this in his own admirably humble way.

articles.title: ‘The wind goes in all directions’: Fleetwood prepare wet welcome for Arsenal at Highbury
articles.summary: The Premier League champions may have bigger fish to fry but can expect a feisty reception from League Two strugglers in the Carabao Cup. The headlines around Fleetwood Town are rarely about what happens on the pitch.
body: It is no different this week, although this time football is taking centre stage as Arsenal head to Highbury Stadium on Tuesday for a Carabao Cup fourth-round tie against the League Two side. There is no link to the Gunners’ former home in Islington and the ground is a world away from what the visitors are used to, its capacity a fraction of the Emirates Stadium. The Championship side Sheffield United were deservedly beaten there in the previous round, unable to cope with their opponents or the conditions, but the Cod Army anticipate a sterner test from Mikel Arteta’s aristocrats.

Even against the Blades, the ground was less than half full but Tuesday will bring the venue’s biggest football attendance; the only other time it has sold out was for a fireworks display. The capacity is 5,300 and the stadium has four parking spaces, leaving Arsenal representatives to find alternatives on the street.

Fleetwood have a loyal local fanbase and occasions such as this can aid growth. Since the draw they have sold about an extra 200 season tickets to supporters keen to guarantee a place at the best show in town.

articles.title: Kylian Mbappé dropped by Chinese brands for ‘offending national sentiments’
articles.summary: Video appears to show football star refer to Mao Zedong as a ‘dictator’ Dongpeng Beverage and Mengniu end deals with France captain. Kylian Mbappé was dropped Tuesday by two major brands in China after a video circulated online in which the French football superstar apparently joked about former…
body: In China jokes about Mao, the country’s founding leader who died in 1976, are considered disrespectful and remain a social taboo.

“Our company firmly opposes and has a zero-tolerance policy towards any behaviour that offends national sentiments,” drinks giant Dongpeng said in a statement, adding that “with immediate effect we are terminating all cooperation with Kylian Mbappe”.
Adverts showing AI-generated images of the 27-year-old France captain drinking a Dongpeng sports drink were regularly shown in China during this year’s World Cup.
Mengniu, China’s largest dairy producer, also cut ties with the Real Madrid forward, who until this incident was hugely popular among Chinese fans with millions of followers on social media.

articles.title: Ulster's Augustus enjoying South Africa homecoming
articles.summary: Ulster back row Juarno Augustus is relishing being back in his native South Africa as he prepares to face his former club Stormers after recovering from ankle surgery.
body: Ulster back row Juarno Augustus says he is "enjoying his rugby again" after recovering from the ankle surgery he underwent in the summer.

This weekend the 28-year-old is preparing to go back to where it all began in terms of his professional playing career as the Irish province face the Stormers in a United Rugby Championship encounter.
Augustus, who played for the Cape Town-based side between 2017 and 2021, is relishing the prospect of coming up against his former team while also spending some precious time with his family.
"It's nice just to be at home. I'll probably need a lot of tickets, everyone's been asking me!" said the former Northampton Saints forward.

articles.title: Smith ruled out of Cape Town Test late due to neck injury
articles.summary: Steve Smith has been ruled out of Australia's third Test decider against South Africa in Cape Town after it was confirmed late on Tuesday morning that the batter had not fully recovered from a neck injury.
body: Australia gave the 37-year-old a chance to prove his fitness ahead of the Test match, which would have seen Smith return to Cape Town for the first time since the infamous 'Sandpapergate' scandal at Newlands in 2018.
Smith appeared to injure himself during his first spell at the crease during Australia's second Test defeat to South Africa in Gqeberha, in which the hosts levelled the series 1-1.
The former skipper subsequently dropped down the batting order in the second innings, as Pat Cummins' side went on to suffer an innings and 31-run defeat.
Ahead of the third Test, Smith had complained of neck stiffness during Australia's pre-match training session and was due to undergo a fitness test ahead of Tuesday's match.

articles.summary: Kiah Stokes starred as the Golden State Valkyries moved to within one victory of a championship in their second season, as they sealed a 64-55 win against Atlanta Dream in Game 5 of the WNBA Finals on Monday night.
body: Back-to-back wins have seen the Valkyries, who had gone 2-1 down in the WNBA Finals series, take a 3-2 lead into Game 6 on Friday.

Stokes had 13 points, eight rebounds and three blocks, while team-mate Veronica Burton contributed a nearly identical stat line with 13 points, eight rebounds and four blocked shots as Golden State got defensive once more to shut down Angel Reese and the Dream.
The Valkyries have leaned on Stokes' steady presence and postseason experience during this remarkable run.
"We're not here without Kiah," Burton said. "Every single day, every single game, from the beginning. Just her veteran experience as well. It's more than just defense."

articles.title: Litten, Knowles to start for England in crunch World Cup match
articles.summary: Jez Litten and Morgan Knowles have been drafted into England's starting line-up for their crunch Rugby League World Cup clash against Papua New Guinea on Friday.
body: Brad O'Neill drops out of the 19-player matchday squad after featuring in England's 82-0 victory against France on Saturday.

Brian McDermott's side must secure victory in their final Group B and C match to keep their hopes of reaching the semi-finals alive. They will then face a nervous two-day wait for Tonga's clash against Samoa.
If Samoa win, England will be knocked out of the Rugby League World Cup at the group stage for the first time in history due to their head-to-head record against Tonga.
Tonga are guaranteed to finish above England, having won two games, including their 30-12 win against McDermott's side in their tournament opener.

articles.title: No Saliba, no problem - Konsa stepping up for Arsenal
articles.summary: Arsenal's defensive form is testament to the performances of Ezri Konsa, who has stepped up in William Saliba's absence and been given his chance to shine.
body: When Arsenal confirmed in July that William Saliba would miss an "extended period" with a long-term back issue, you can forgive fans for panicking.

The Frenchman has formed a formidable pairing with Gabriel Magalhaes as part of the Gunners' well-drilled backline that conceded just 27 league goals last season as they lifted the Premier League title.
Eight games into the new season and Saliba still hasn't featured, but Mikel Arteta's side have conceded the fewest goals in the Premier League as they sit level on points at the summit.

Before Arsenal signed the 29-year-old for £55m from Aston Villa in August, questions were asked. Is it too much money? Do the Gunners need him with Cristhian Mosquera already in the squad? Why bring in Konsa and not a forward?

articles.title: Multinational Black and Whites await in last 16
articles.summary: Trip to Bregenz on Wednesday. The Round of 16 of the UNIQA ÖFB Cup is just around the corner. Tomorrow evening, our boys will visit SW Bregenz. The match kicks off at 18:00 CET under the lights at the ImmoAgentur Stadion, marking the start of our week in Vorarlberg.
body: One thing that has distinguished the Black and Whites in recent seasons is their knack for pulling off cup upsets - for instance, they eliminated GAK in the Round of 16 in 2024/25. Last season, the side from western Austria was only defeated by SV Ried in extra-time. Our only previous cup encounter was not so dramatic: during our 2020/21 cup-winning run, we dispatched the Bregenz side 10-0.

Can we make it through to the next stage of the cup this season? The game be featured as part of a conference broadcast on ORF 1, and can be watched in its entirety on ORF ON and ÖFB TV. The quarter-finalists will be determined on Sunday, following the Vienna derby, on ORF 1 (at approximately 19:00).

Enrique Aguilar (thigh), Justin Omoregie (ankle) and Nikolas Veratschnig (knee) remain unavailable. Additionally, four more players are sidelined following the match against LASK: Leandro Morgalla and Damir Redzic are currently unavailable due to muscular issues. Dominik Schmid has sustained a knee sprain, with further examinations to follow. Sota Kitano is also out after taking a knock to his ankle.

articles.title: Kennedy 'not done yet' as he targets more titles
articles.summary: Jack Kennedy is the most successful rider in the history of the British Supersport Championship but says he is "not done yet". Irish rider Kennedy is a five-time champion in the Supersport class but had to settle for second behind Luke Stapleford in the 2026 standings.
body: He will return for another shot at the title in 2027 as he sticks with the Honda manufacturer team, and says he is aiming to go one better next year.
"A lot of hard work and dedication has got me to where I am now," Kennedy told the BBC Bikes podcast.
"I'm grateful for all of the opportunities I've been given and all the great teams and manufacturers I've ridden for.
"I'm not done and I want more. There's nothing to say we can't win one, two, three or four more championships. Why not?".

articles.title: Eight Two-Out Runs Later, Brewers Are One Win Away From First-Ever World Series Title
articles.summary: After a 10-1 demolition of the Rays at Tropicana Field, the Brewers are one win away from celebrating their franchise’s first World Series title.
body: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. — Years from now, when someone wants to remember this inexorable, incessant, indomitable Milwaukee machine that is one win away from immortality, point them to the fifth inning of Game 3 of the World Series.

The Brewers do not simply win games. They overwhelm opponents to the point of exhaustion, then rip away their will. They work counts persistently, knock starters out swiftly, put the ball in play repeatedly and punish mistakes forcefully. Sometimes, as they did Monday night in a two-out rally for the record books that gave them a 3-0 lead in the Fall Classic, they do it all at once.
"I don’t think it’ll ever sink in that we’re this close," pitcher Jacob Misiorowski told me.

Milwaukee demands perfection from its foes, and even then that is typically not enough, considering the Brewers' ability to erase deficits in the blink of an eye and stifle opponents with their shutdown bullpen. They have trailed in all but two of their 11 playoff games and have won 10 of them anyway.
